problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=6\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t),$ where $t\ge 0$ is the time  in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=1\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=0\,\text{s},$ calculate the maximum velocity ${v}_{\text{max}}$ of the particle and determine the earliest time when the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Characteristics of Moving Objects Using Integration
